description: This file implements a gRPC server for GNSS data proxying, including handling GPS data, raw measurements, and fixed location data, with support for reading from files and serial communication.

classes.name: GnssGrpcProxyServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the gRPC service handling GNSS data, including GPS, raw measurements, and fixed location data, with threading for serial communication and file reading.

methods.name: GenerateGpsLine
methods.description: Generates a GPS data line string with current timestamp and provided data point.

methods.name: SendGps
methods.description: Handles incoming GPS data requests and updates cached location.

methods.name: ConvertCoordinate
methods.description: Converts GpsCoordinates protobuf message to comma-separated string.

methods.name: SendGpsVector
methods.description: Handles incoming GPS coordinate vector requests and updates internal queue and delay.

methods.name: sendToSerial
methods.description: Sends the cached fixed location to the serial interface.

methods.name: sendGnssRawToSerial
methods.description: Sends cached GNSS raw measurement data to the serial interface if valid and changed.

methods.name: StartServer
methods.description: Starts threads for serial communication and data reading.

methods.name: StartReadFixedLocationFileThread
methods.description: Starts thread to read fixed location data from file.

methods.name: StartReadGnssRawMeasurementFileThread
methods.description: Starts thread to read GNSS raw measurement data from file.

methods.name: ReadFixedLocationFromLocalFile
methods.description: Reads fixed location data from a specified file at 1Hz.

methods.name: ReadGnssRawMeasurement
methods.description: Reads GNSS raw measurement data from a specified file at 1Hz.

methods.name: getTimeNanosFromLine
methods.description: Extracts the TimeNanos value from a data line.

methods.name: isGnssRawMeasurement
methods.description: Checks if a string is a GNSS raw measurement line.

methods.name: ReadMeasurementLoop
methods.description: Continuously reads raw measurement commands from gnss_out_.

methods.name: ReadFixedLocLoop
methods.description: Continuously reads location commands from fixed_location_out_.

methods.name: WriteFixedLocationFromQueue
methods.description: Thread function to generate GPS lines from queue and update cache.

methods.name: RunServer
methods.description: Configures and runs the gRPC server or file reading in local mode.
